tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Find live jobs when the user has a keyword, place, company, remote, and/or seniority, not a theyond job URL (use get_job for that). Need q, location, company, remote=true, seniority, or new=true. new=true searches just-added jobs on homepage Hiring now (same set as hiring_now), still max 10. Not pos

tools.name: hiring_now
tools.description: What's new on theyond.com with no keyword. Hiring now companies, plus up to 10 just-added jobs. job_count is how many were just added. Show the theyond.com URLs you were given, including title_hub_url, location_hub_url, or location_title_hub_url when present. Not posted_at, not an employer apply URL

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Use after search_jobs or hiring_now when the user picked one job. Pass that job's url from search_jobs or hiring_now (or its slug). Do not use this to search. Plain-text description, cut at 2000 characters when description_truncated is true. Cite hub URLs on the card. No employer apply URL.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
